name: Ostrhauderfehn (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ostrhauderfehn (a red sailing boat on yellow under a blue chief with a peat spade).
history: Municipal flag of Ostrhauderfehn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ostrhauderfehn arms — sailing boat and peat spade
